seed_group.doc: Starting elements; empty selects no seeds except in Regions mode.

avoid_group.doc: Elements excluded from selection and traversal.

allowed_group.doc: Elements traversal may visit; empty allows all.

barrier_group.doc: Elements that block traversal and are excluded.

target_group.doc: Elements at which Flood to Target stops.

max_steps.doc: Maximum topological hops from a seed; -1 disables the limit.

max_distance.doc: Maximum geodesic distance; -1 disables Dijkstra distance traversal.

stop_at_boundary.doc: Stop expansion at mesh boundary elements.

max_angle.doc: Maximum degrees between neighboring face normals or consecutive point and edge traversal steps.

attr_name.doc: Optional scalar or vector attribute on the chosen domain used to gate traversal.

attr_mode.doc: Compare candidate attribute to seed, current neighbor, or zero threshold.

attr_tolerance.doc: Maximum Euclidean attribute difference or threshold magnitude.

direction.doc: Optional preferred traversal direction; zero disables the filter.

max_deviation.doc: Maximum degrees that a traversal step may deviate from Direction.

mode.doc: Flood from seeds, stop at first target, or label connected regions.

combine.doc: How to combine selection with an existing output group.

frontier_group.doc: Optional group marking the selection frontier.

store_step_distance.doc: Write int32 step_distance, with -1 for unvisited elements.

store_surface_distance.doc: Write float32 surface_distance, with -1 for unvisited elements.
